Brokerage insights

MetaTrader Grey Label Licensing: What It Includes and Why It Matters

Practical perspectives on brokerage technology and operations.

5 min read · Meta Grey Label

The context

There’s a mix-up that comes up in almost every early conversation with new brokers. Someone hears “license” and assumes it means regulatory approval. It doesn’t. A metatrader grey label license is a technology arrangement. It gives you the right to run your own MetaTrader server under a provider’s master license. It says nothing about whether you’re allowed to offer trading services in a given country.

That distinction matters, and so does knowing exactly what you’re paying for. Here’s a clear look at both.

01 / Explore the detail

Two Very Different Kinds of License

When brokers talk about licensing, they’re usually mixing up two separate things.

The first is your financial or regulatory license. That comes from a regulator, whether that’s a tier-one body or an offshore authority, and it’s what makes your brokerage legal to operate. It covers things like capital requirements, client fund segregation, reporting and compliance staff.

The second is your platform license. That’s your right to use MetaTrader software commercially. MetaQuotes issues full licenses to brokers directly, but they’re costly and hard to get, and new MT4 licenses haven’t been available for years. A grey label is a way to get platform access without going down that route.

You need both. A grey label covers the technology side only. Any reputable provider will ask about your regulatory status before they set you up.

02 / Explore the detail

How a Grey Label License Actually Works

The provider holds a full MetaTrader license from MetaQuotes. Under that license, they deploy a dedicated server instance for your brokerage. It runs separately from other brokers, carries your branding, and you control it at admin level.

So you’re not technically the license holder in MetaQuotes’ eyes. Your provider is. But day to day, you’re running your own server with much of the control a full licensee would have.

That middle ground is where the name comes from. White label is fully shared and fully hosted. A full license is fully yours. Grey sits between the two.

03 / Explore the detail

What’s Typically Included

Packages vary between providers, so always read the agreement line by line. That said, most grey label arrangements cover something like this:

01

The Server and Its Infrastructure

A dedicated MetaTrader server instance, usually MT5

Hosting in a data centre of your choice, or one the provider recommends

A backup server for failover

Ongoing maintenance, security patches and platform updates from MetaQuotes

02

Terminals and Access

Administrator terminal, giving you full control of server settings

Manager terminals for your dealing desk, support and back office teams

Branded client terminals for desktop, web, iOS and Android

Your own server name, so clients search for your brand when they log in

03

Configuration Rights

This is where the real value sits. With admin access, you can set up symbols, groups, leverage, margin rules, swaps, commissions and execution settings yourself. You choose your liquidity providers. You can install plugins and connect third-party tools without asking the host for permission every time.

04

Support

Most providers include technical support, though the level differs a lot. Some offer round-the-clock monitoring. Others answer emails during office hours. Ask specifically what happens if your server has a problem on a Sunday night before the market opens.

04 / Explore the detail

What’s Usually Not Included

This catches people out. A grey label license generally does not include:

Your regulatory license or legal setup

Liquidity, which you contract separately, even if the provider introduces you

Bridge, CRM, risk tools or other plugins, unless they’re bundled

Payment processing

Your website and marketing

Some providers do offer bundles that bring several of these together. That can be convenient, but check each component’s pricing so you know what you’re really paying for.

05 / Explore the detail

The Real Grey Label License Benefits

So why do so many brokers go this way instead of a white label or a full license? The grey label license benefits come down to a few practical points.

Control without the full price. You get admin-level access and your own server for a fraction of what a full MetaQuotes license costs. For most mid-sized brokers, the full license simply isn’t worth it.

Freedom over liquidity and execution. You aren’t tied to the host’s liquidity or their way of handling orders. You can run A-book, B-book or hybrid on your own terms, and switch liquidity providers if pricing or fills get worse.

Your data stays separate. Client and trade data sit on your own server instance, not on a shared server with other brokers. Regulators and institutional partners tend to look more kindly on that.

Room to grow. As your volume increases, you can add plugins, adjust your setup and scale without migrating to a new platform. Many brokers stay on a grey label for years.

Faster launch than a full license. Getting a full license approved and built can take months. A grey label can be running in days once your paperwork is in order.

06 / Explore the detail

Questions to Ask Before You Sign

Since you’re relying on your provider’s master license, their reliability becomes your reliability. Before committing, it’s worth asking:

How long have they held their MetaQuotes license, and is it in good standing?

What happens to your server and client data if the agreement ends?

Can you migrate to another provider or to your own license later?

What exactly is covered in the monthly fee, and what costs extra?

What uptime do they guarantee, and what happens if they miss it?

The answer to the second question in particular tells you a lot. A provider confident in their service won’t make leaving painful.

07 / Explore the detail

Why It Matters for Your Brokerage

Your platform sits at the centre of everything. Clients trade on it, your dealers manage risk through it, and your reports come out of it. Choosing the wrong licensing setup can quietly limit how you price, how you execute and how quickly you can grow.

A metatrader grey label license isn’t the right fit for every brokerage. Very new brokers on tight budgets may be better off starting with a white label. But for brokers who want real control without taking on the cost and complexity of a full license, it’s often the most practical choice available.

08 / Explore the detail

Conclusion

Understand what you’re buying, keep platform licensing and regulatory licensing separate in your head, and read the agreement carefully. Do that, and the grey label license benefits become very clear in how your brokerage runs.

If you’d like a clear breakdown of what a grey label package would include for your setup, MetaGreyLabel can walk you through it.

Brokerage insights

MetaTrader Grey Label vs White Label: Which Is Best for Your Forex Brokerage?

Practical perspectives on brokerage technology and operations.

5 min read · Meta Grey Label

The context

Most brokers don’t start out asking about server architecture. They start with a budget, a launch date, and a rough sense that they need MetaTrader because that’s what their traders already use. Then someone mentions grey label, someone else says white label, and the conversation gets murky fast.

So let’s untangle it. The MetaTrader grey label vs white label question isn’t really about which one is better. It comes down to how much of your brokerage you want to own on day one, and how much you’re happy to rent.

01 / Explore the detail

A Quick Bit of Background First

MetaQuotes, the company behind MT4 and MT5, sells full server licenses directly. They’re expensive and come with strict requirements, and new MT4 licenses are no longer issued at all. That gap is why white label and grey label models exist. Providers who already hold full licenses carve out access and offer it to newer brokers at a much lower entry cost.

Both routes put your brand on the terminal your clients log into. The difference is in what’s happening behind that login screen.

02 / Explore the detail

What a White Label Actually Gives You

With a white label, you’re basically a tenant. The provider runs the server, and your brokerage sits on it as a branded segment alongside other brokers. Your clients see your name and logo. You get a manager terminal, reporting tools, and the ability to open accounts and set up some trading groups.

01

Where White Label Works Well

Speed is the big one. A white label can often go live in a couple of weeks because there’s nothing to build. It’s cheaper too, both upfront and month to month, which matters a lot when you’re still finding out whether your marketing can bring in funded clients.

It also suits brokers who’d rather not think about infrastructure at all. The provider handles uptime, backups, security patches and plugin updates.

02

Where It Starts to Pinch

The trade-off is control. You’re working inside someone else’s setup. Want a bridge to a liquidity provider they don’t support? You might wait, or you might go without. Need a custom plugin, or a different approach to execution and risk? That’s usually something you have to request, not something you decide.

Then there’s the shared server. If the host has an outage, every broker on it has one too. And your client data sits on infrastructure you don’t control, which can make some regulators and institutional partners uneasy.

03 / Explore the detail

What Changes With a Grey Label

A grey label sits in the middle ground between a white label and a full license. You get your own dedicated MetaTrader server instance, usually MT5 these days. It runs under the provider’s master license but is kept separate from other brokers.

In practice, that means admin access, not just manager access. You configure symbols, groups, swaps, margin rules and execution settings yourself. You pick your liquidity providers and bridges, and you can install plugins that fit how you want to run your book. Your client data stays on your own server.

01

Who Grey Label Suits

Brokers who already have some traction usually get the most out of it. If you have a client base, a clear plan for A-book, B-book or hybrid execution, and a team that knows its way around a MetaTrader admin panel, a grey label lets you run things your way.

It’s also a sensible next step if you’ve outgrown a white label but aren’t ready for a full license, or can’t get one.

02

The Extra Cost and Work

More control means more work. Setup and monthly fees are higher than for a white label. You’ll need people, in-house or outsourced, who can manage the server, watch risk and keep the configuration clean. Launch also takes longer because there’s real setup involved.

04 / Explore the detail

The Part That Hits Your Margins

This is where the difference grey vs white label setups make really shows: how much room you have to shape your revenue.

On a white label, spreads, markups, commission structures and hedging all sit within limits the host sets. On a grey label, you set those limits yourself. That doesn’t make it automatically more profitable. A badly configured grey label can lose money faster than a well-run white label ever would. But the ceiling is higher, and the decisions are yours.

A quick side-by-side:

Control: white label gives you manager access, grey label gives you admin access to your own server

Liquidity: white label ties you to the host’s options, grey label lets you choose

Launch time: white label is usually quicker

Cost: white label is cheaper to start and to run

Data: on a white label it sits on a shared server, on a grey label it sits on yours

05 / Explore the detail

So Which One Should You Pick?

Honestly, it depends on where your brokerage is today, not where you hope it’ll be in three years.

If you’re new, testing a market or working with a tight budget, a white label is usually the smarter place to start. You get to market quickly, see what your clients actually trade, and keep costs under control. Plenty of successful brokers started this way and moved on later.

If you already have clients, a defined execution model and some technical depth in-house, a grey label starts to make more sense. The extra cost earns its keep once the host’s restrictions are costing you money or clients.

Before you decide, it’s worth asking yourself a few things:

How many funded clients do you realistically expect in the first year?

Do you have someone who can manage a MetaTrader server, or will you need to hire?

Are you tied to particular liquidity providers?

What does your regulator expect around data storage and server control?

If most of your answers are “not yet” or “not sure,” start with a white label. If they’re “yes, and it’s already a problem,” look seriously at a grey label. In the end, the difference grey vs white label models come down to is simple: who holds the keys.

06 / Explore the detail

Conclusion

The MetaTrader grey label vs white label decision isn’t permanent. Lots of brokers launch on a white label, build volume, then move to a grey label once they need more control. That path is perfectly reasonable, and often cheaper than jumping straight into infrastructure you’re not ready to run.

If you’re thinking about the move, the team at MetaGreyLabel can show you what a grey label setup would look like for your brokerage, and whether now is the right time to make it.

Mobile Trading App (iOS / Android)

The context

Watch how most people trade now and you’ll notice something. The phone comes out first. They check positions over breakfast, react to news on the train, close a trade in a queue at the supermarket. For a growing share of traders, the phone isn’t a backup. It’s the main way they trade.

A reliable mobile trading app for brokers isn’t a nice extra anymore. It’s expected. If your clients can’t trade comfortably on their phones, they’ll find a broker where they can.

01 / Explore the detail

Why Mobile Matters So Much

01

Markets Don’t Wait

Prices move at all hours. A trader who can only act from a desktop misses opportunities and can’t protect positions when something unexpected happens.

02

Clients Check In Constantly

Even traders who do their analysis on a desktop tend to monitor positions on their phone throughout the day. That’s often when they decide to close, adjust or add to a trade.

03

New Traders Start on Mobile

Many newer, younger traders have never used a desktop trading terminal at all. For them, the app is your brokerage.

02 / Explore the detail

MT4 MT5 Mobile App Features

The MT4 MT5 mobile app gives your clients a full trading experience in their pocket, connected to the same accounts they use on desktop and web.

01

Live Prices and Charts

Real-time quotes, interactive charts with multiple timeframes, and a range of built-in technical indicators and drawing tools.

02

Full Order Management

Open and close positions, place pending orders, and set or adjust stop loss and take profit levels in a few taps.

03

Account Overview

Balance, equity, margin, free margin and open positions, all visible at a glance.

04

Trade History

Clients can review past trades and account activity whenever they need to.

05

Push Notifications

Price alerts and trade notifications keep clients informed even when the app is closed.

06

Financial News

Built-in news feeds help traders stay on top of market events without switching apps.

03 / Explore the detail

MT4 Mobile vs MT5 Mobile

01

MT4 Mobile App

Ideal for forex-focused traders who already use MT4. It’s simple, fast and handles core trading tasks well.

02

MT5 Mobile App

Better suited to multi-asset brokerages. It supports more instruments, more timeframes and more order types, and offers a slightly richer charting experience.

03

Offering Both

If you run both platforms, clients can download either app and log in with the matching account.

04 / Explore the detail

iOS Android Trading App Coverage

A proper iOS Android trading app setup means none of your clients are left out, whatever phone they use.

01

iPhone and iPad

Clients on Apple devices download MetaTrader from the App Store and connect to your server.

02

Android Phones and Tablets

Android users download from Google Play and connect the same way.

03

One Login Everywhere

Clients use the same account details on mobile as they do on desktop and web. Positions and balances stay in sync across every device.

05 / Explore the detail

How Clients Find Your Brokerage in the App

This part often confuses new brokers, so it’s worth explaining clearly.

01

The Standard MetaTrader App

Most brokers’ clients use the official MetaTrader app, published by MetaQuotes. After downloading it, clients search for your server name and log in with their account details. Your server name and company appear inside the app.

02

Making It Easy for Clients

We set up your server name clearly and help you create simple step-by-step guides, direct download links and QR codes for your website and trader’s room. That way clients connect to the right server first time.

06 / Explore the detail

White Label Forex Trading App Options

Some brokers want a fully branded app with their own name and icon in the app stores. A white label forex trading app like this is possible, but it depends on your licence level and setup.

01

When It’s Available

Brokers holding their own MetaTrader licence, or working with certain third-party app providers, may be able to publish a branded mobile app. Availability, cost and timelines vary.

02

Is It Worth It?

A branded app can strengthen your brand and make marketing easier. But for many new brokers, the standard MetaTrader app with clear onboarding works perfectly well. We’ll give you an honest view of which makes sense for your stage.

07 / Explore the detail

Part of Your Complete Platform Offering

Mobile works best alongside desktop and web, not instead of them. Most active traders use all three at different times. With our white label, grey label and turnkey setups, mobile access is configured with the rest of your platform, linked to your trader’s room and tested before launch.

Whether you’re setting up MT4 MT5 mobile app access, planning full iOS Android trading app coverage, or exploring a branded white label forex trading app, we’ll help you choose and set up the right option. Get in touch today.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

Do clients need a separate account to trade on mobile?

No. They use the same login details as on desktop and web, and everything stays in sync.

Can I have my own branded app in the App Store and Google Play?

Possibly, depending on your licence and setup. Many brokers start with the standard MetaTrader app and consider a branded app as they grow.

Can clients use expert advisors on mobile?

No. Expert advisors and most custom indicators run on the desktop terminal. The mobile app is built for manual trading, monitoring and quick decisions.

Does the mobile app work on tablets?

Yes. MetaTrader runs on iPads and Android tablets as well as phones.

09 / Explore the detail

Put Your Brokerage in Every Client’s Pocket

Your clients carry their phones everywhere. Make sure your brokerage goes with them. A dependable mobile trading app for brokers keeps clients connected, active and confident in your service.

The context

Every broker starts somewhere. Some begin on a white label, others on a grey label, and a few go straight for the real thing. Whichever route you take, there’s a point where owning your trading infrastructure becomes the logical choice.

An admin licence means the MetaTrader server is yours. Your company holds the licence, your team has full administrator access and every decision about how the platform runs sits with you. This page explains what that involves, who it suits and how we help you set it up properly.

01 / Operational scope

What Is an MT4 or MT5 Admin License?

It’s a full server licence for MetaTrader, issued in your company’s name. Unlike white or grey label arrangements, you aren’t working inside someone else’s environment. You own it.

With an MT4 admin license or MT5 admin license, you get administrator access to the server itself. That covers server settings, plugins, data feeds, gateways, backups, security and every group and symbol on the platform. Nothing needs approval from a provider above you.

01

Admin Access vs Manager Access

On a grey label, you work with manager access. That’s enough to run groups, trading conditions and client accounts. Admin access goes deeper. You control the server configuration, install plugins, connect any gateway you choose and decide how the infrastructure is hosted and maintained.

02 / Operational scope

Why Brokers Choose Their Own MetaTrader License

Holding your own MetaTrader license isn’t right for everyone. But for brokers at the right stage, it changes a lot.

01

Complete Independence

No provider limits on plugins, integrations or server settings. If you want to run custom risk tools, connect a specific liquidity bridge or build server-side logic, you can.

02

Stronger Credibility

Banks, payment providers, regulators and institutional clients often take a broker more seriously when it owns its infrastructure. It signals commitment and long-term stability.

03

Better Long-Term Economics

The upfront cost is higher, but there are no ongoing grey label fees tied to a provider’s server. For brokers with solid volumes, owning the licence often works out cheaper over a few years.

04

Full Control Over Your Data

Client data, trading history and server logs sit on infrastructure you control. That matters for compliance, audits and peace of mind.

03 / Operational scope

MT4 Admin License or MT5 Admin License?

Both give you full ownership. The right one depends on your traders and your product plans.

01

MT4 Admin License

Best for brokers with a forex-focused audience that relies on MT4 indicators and expert advisors. It’s familiar, stable and still widely used. One thing to note: new MT4 licences have become harder to obtain as MetaQuotes focuses on MT5, so availability is worth checking early.

02

MT5 Admin License

The natural choice for most new licence holders. MT5 handles forex, metals, indices, stocks, futures and crypto CFDs in one platform, supports both hedging and netting, and is where new features and integrations arrive first.

03

Running Both

Some brokers hold both licences so they can serve every type of trader. It adds cost and admin work, but it removes any platform barrier for new clients.

04 / Operational scope

What Comes With a MetaTrader License for Brokers

A MetaTrader license for brokers gives you the core server and platform. To turn it into a working brokerage, you’ll typically need several more pieces around it.

01

Core Components

The trading server, administrator and manager terminals, client terminals for desktop, web and mobile, and the data and history servers your platform runs on.

02

What You’ll Need Alongside It

Hosting in a reliable data centre, a liquidity bridge, a forex CRM and client portal, payment gateway integrations, risk management tools, backup and disaster recovery, and people who know how to keep it all running. We can help with every one of these.

05 / Operational scope

How We Help You Set Up Your Admin License

Owning a server is one thing. Getting it configured, connected and stable is where most brokers need support.

01

Licensing Guidance

We walk you through the licensing process, the documents you’ll need and what to expect, so there are no surprises along the way.

02

Server Setup and Hosting

We set up your server environment, configure it for performance and security, and help you choose hosting that suits your markets and latency needs.

03

Integrations

Liquidity bridge, CRM, client portal, payment gateways and plugins, all configured and tested together before you go live.

04

Ongoing Server Management

After launch, we can manage the server for you completely, support your in-house team, or step in only when you need specialist help. You choose the level.

06 / Operational scope

Is an Admin License Right for You Yet?

We’ll be straight with you. An admin licence is a big commitment. It suits brokers with steady volumes, a clear growth plan, and either an in-house technical team or a trusted partner to manage the server.

If you’re just starting out or still testing a market, a white label or grey label is usually the smarter first move. Many of our clients start there and move to their own licence once the numbers justify it. We’ll help you work out which stage you’re at.

07 / Operational scope

Take Full Ownership of Your Trading Platform

An MT4 admin license or MT5 admin license puts your brokerage on infrastructure that truly belongs to you. More control, more credibility and more room to build exactly the business you want.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does an MT4 or MT5 admin licence cost?

It depends on the licence type, your hosting choices, integrations and support level. Licence fees are set by MetaQuotes, and setup and management costs vary by provider. Share your plans with us and we’ll give you a clear, itemised estimate.

How long does it take to get my own MetaTrader licence?

The licensing process can take several weeks, depending on your documents and MetaQuotes’ review. Server setup and integrations usually run in parallel, so you can launch soon after approval.

Can I move my existing grey label clients to my own licence?

Yes. We can migrate client accounts, balances and trading history from a grey label to your new server, usually over a weekend, with minimal disruption to your traders.

Do I need a regulatory licence before applying?

Requirements vary. MetaQuotes may ask for company and regulatory documents during the process, and your target markets will have their own rules. Your legal advisor should confirm what applies to you.

The context

MT4 is still the platform a huge number of forex traders reach for first. It’s familiar, dependable and backed by years of custom indicators and expert advisors. For a broker whose clients live on MT4, owning the server behind it can be a serious advantage.

An MT4 admin license puts that server in your hands. Your company holds the licence, your team has administrator access and every decision about how the platform runs is yours. This page covers what that involves, what it costs, how setup works and what you should know before you commit.

01 / Operational scope

What an MT4 Admin License Gives You

With your own licence, you’re no longer operating inside someone else’s environment. The MT4 server, its configuration and everything running on it belong to your brokerage.

01

Administrator-Level Access

You control server settings, plugins, gateways, data feeds, backups and security. Your team can make changes whenever needed without asking a provider for permission.

02

Full Control Over Trading Operations

Groups, symbols, spreads, swaps, leverage, trading sessions and execution settings are all set by you. You can build your offer exactly the way your clients need it.

03

Ownership of Client Data

Trading history, client records and server logs sit on infrastructure your company controls. That makes compliance reviews and audits far more straightforward.

02 / Operational scope

An Important Note on MT4 Server License Availability

Before you plan around an MT4 server license, there’s something you should know. MetaQuotes has focused heavily on MT5 for several years and has largely stopped issuing brand new MT4 server licences.

That doesn’t always rule MT4 out. Some brokers already hold MT4 licences, and in certain cases there may be other routes worth exploring. But it does mean availability needs checking early, before you build your plans around it.

01

Why We Mention This Upfront

Some providers skip over this until well into the process. We’d rather you know at the start, so you can weigh MT4 against MT5 properly and avoid wasting time or money.

02

The MT5 Alternative

If a new MT4 licence isn’t available for your situation, an MT5 admin licence is usually the natural option. MT5 supports forex alongside metals, indices, stocks and futures, and most MT4 traders adapt to it within a few days.

03 / Operational scope

Understanding MT4 Admin Cost

The MT4 admin cost is made up of several pieces, and it’s worth looking at each one rather than a single headline figure.

01

Licence Fees

Where an MT4 licence is available, the licence fee itself is set by MetaQuotes or determined by the specific arrangement. This is usually the largest upfront cost.

02

Hosting and Infrastructure

Your server needs to run in a reliable data centre, ideally close to your liquidity providers for low latency. Hosting costs depend on location, performance requirements and backup needs.

03

Integrations

Liquidity bridge, forex CRM, client portal, payment gateways and risk management plugins all add to the total. Some brokers already have several of these in place.

04

Ongoing Management

Someone has to keep the server healthy. That could be your own team, a managed service from us, or a combination. Monthly costs depend on how much support you need.

05

Getting an Accurate Figure

Because so much depends on your setup, the most reliable way to get a real number is to share your plans with us. We’ll send back an itemised estimate showing exactly where the money goes.

04 / Operational scope

MT4 Admin Setup: How the Process Works

A good MT4 admin setup is mostly about careful planning. Rushing it is how brokers end up with downtime and unhappy clients.

01

Step One: Assessment

We look at your current position. Do you already hold a licence? Are you moving from a grey label? Which markets are you serving? That shapes the whole plan.

02

Step Two: Infrastructure

We help you choose hosting, set up the server environment and configure it for performance, stability and security.

03

Step Three: Configuration

Groups, symbols, trading conditions, plugins and gateways are set up to match your business model. If you’re moving from a grey label, we replicate your existing setup and improve on it where needed.

04

Step Four: Integrations and Testing

Your CRM, client portal, payments and liquidity bridge are connected and tested together. Your team runs through real scenarios before anything goes live.

05

Step Five: Launch and Support

You go live with full administrator access. We stay involved for as long as you want, from full server management to occasional specialist help.

05 / Operational scope

Who an MT4 Admin License Suits

Owning an MT4 server makes most sense for established brokers with strong MT4 audiences, firms already holding an MT4 licence who need better setup and management, and grey label brokers whose volumes now justify their own infrastructure. You’ll also want either a technical team or a reliable partner to manage the server day to day.

If you’re new to the industry, a grey label is often the better starting point. We’ll tell you honestly which fits.

06 / Operational scope

Take Full Control of Your MT4 Brokerage

An MT4 admin license gives you ownership, control and credibility that shared infrastructure can’t match. But it’s a big step, and it deserves honest advice and careful planning.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I still get a new MT4 admin licence?

New MT4 server licences are very limited, as MetaQuotes now focuses on MT5. Availability depends on your situation, so it’s best to check early. If MT4 isn’t possible, we’ll walk you through MT5 as an alternative.

I already have an MT4 licence. Can you manage it for me?

Yes. We can take over setup, hosting, configuration and ongoing management of an existing MT4 server, or support your in-house team where they need help.

Can I run MT5 alongside my MT4 server?

Yes. Many brokers keep MT4 for existing clients and add MT5 for new instruments and newer traders. We can set up and manage both.

How long does MT4 admin setup take?

If you already hold a licence, server setup and integrations can often be completed within a few weeks. Migrations from a grey label are usually done over a weekend to avoid disrupting traders.

The context

MT4 has outlasted a lot of predictions. Every few years someone says it’s on the way out, and every year millions of traders keep opening it each morning. Their indicators are on it, their EAs are on it, and they really don’t want to start over somewhere else.

For a broker, that loyalty is useful. An MT4 grey label lets you offer the platform those traders already know, under your own brand, with the manager-level control to run your business properly. You get the independence of a serious brokerage without paying for a full MT4 server licence.

01 / Explore the detail

What an MT4 Grey Label Includes

Your brokerage runs on an MT4 server that’s already licensed, hosted and maintained by us. On top of that, you get your own manager and admin access, your own account groups and the freedom to set your trading conditions.

In short, the server and its upkeep are our job. How your brokerage runs on it is yours.

01

Manager Terminal Access

Your dealing team can see open positions, monitor exposure, manage client accounts and adjust settings in real time. No waiting on someone else to make a change.

02

Your Own Groups and Conditions

Create groups for different client types, regions or account tiers. Set spreads, commissions, swaps and leverage for each one. If a new strategy needs a new group, you set it up yourself.

03

Full Branding

The terminal, client portal and communications all carry your name. Traders see your brokerage, nobody else’s.

02 / Explore the detail

Why Run as a Grey Label MT4 Broker?

Operating as a grey label MT4 broker puts you in a strong middle position. You’re not limited the way white label brokers often are, and you’re not carrying the huge cost and technical weight of a full licence.

01

Keep Your Existing Traders Happy

If you’re an introducing broker or educator with an MT4 audience, moving them to a new platform is a real risk. Some will follow you. Some won’t. Staying on MT4 removes that friction completely.

02

Run Your Own Risk Strategy

With a grey label, you decide how client flow is handled. Route some to liquidity providers, keep some in-house, treat different groups differently. That flexibility directly affects how much your brokerage can earn.

03

Move Faster Than Your Competitors

When conditions change, you can adjust spreads or leverage the same day. Brokers on restricted setups often have to request changes and wait, which costs them clients during volatile periods.

03 / Explore the detail

Our MT4 Grey Label Solution

Our MT4 grey label solution goes beyond handing you a server login. It’s built to give you a working brokerage, with every key piece connected and tested before launch.

01

The Core Setup

A branded MT4 environment for desktop, web and mobile. Manager and admin terminals. Configured groups, symbols and trading conditions. Connection to your liquidity bridge and back office tools.

02

Optional Additions

A forex CRM with KYC and onboarding, a trader’s room for deposits and withdrawals, payment gateway integrations, an IB module for partners and a branded website. Plugins for copy trading, PAMM and MAM can be added as your client base grows.

03

Tested as One System

Everything is configured to work together. Your CRM syncs with MT4, deposits reach trading accounts properly and reports match. It’s the boring part of the job, and it’s the part that saves you the most hours later.

04 / Explore the detail

What Does MT4 Grey Label Cost?

The MT4 grey label cost sits above a white label and well below a full licence. Exactly where it lands depends on what you need, so here’s what shapes the final figure.

01

Factors That Affect the Price

The number of client accounts you expect. How many groups and custom symbols you need. Whether you want MT4 alone or MT4 alongside MT5. Which add-ons you take, like CRM, website or extra payment gateways. And the level of support you’d like.

02

Setup Fee and Monthly Fee

You’ll pay a one-time setup fee covering configuration, branding, integrations and testing, plus a monthly fee for server access, maintenance and support. We list both clearly in your proposal.

03

No Hidden Extras

Routine configuration changes are part of your monthly fee. If you ever need something beyond your package, we quote it first and you decide. Nothing shows up on an invoice that you haven’t agreed to.

05 / Explore the detail

Who an MT4 Grey Label Suits

It’s a good fit for white label brokers who’ve outgrown their restrictions, IBs with strong MT4 volumes ready to run their own book, and established firms launching a forex-focused brand. If most of your traders are forex specialists who rely on MT4 tools, it’s usually the most practical choice.

If you’re planning to expand heavily into stocks, indices or futures, we may suggest MT5 alongside it. We’ll talk that through with you openly.

06 / Explore the detail

Launch Your MT4 Grey Label Brokerage

Your traders already know MT4. Give them the platform they’re comfortable with, under your own brand, with the control you need to grow. An MT4 grey label makes that possible without the cost of a full licence.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

Can my traders use their existing MT4 indicators and EAs?

Yes. Because it’s standard MT4, traders can bring their custom indicators, scripts and expert advisors with them. That’s one of the biggest reasons brokers choose MT4 for their grey label.

Can I add MT5 later?

Absolutely. Many brokers start on MT4 and add MT5 once they want to offer more asset classes. We can run both side by side so clients choose the platform they prefer.

How quickly can an MT4 grey label go live?

Once your documents, branding and trading conditions are agreed, a standard setup can be live within a few days. Extra integrations or complex group structures can add a little time, and we’ll tell you upfront if they will.

Do I need my own dealing team?

It helps. A grey label gives you real control over risk and conditions, and you’ll get the most from it with someone managing that side. If you don’t have a team yet, we can talk through whether a white label is a better first step.

The context

Some platforms come and go. MetaTrader 4 has stuck around for close to two decades, and there’s a simple reason. Traders know it, trust it and have built their whole routine around it. Their indicators, their expert advisors, their chart layouts, all of it lives on MT4.

If your target traders are already on MT4, giving them the same platform under your brand makes onboarding a lot easier. That’s exactly what an MT4 white label does. You get a fully working platform with your name on it, without buying a server licence or hiring a technical team.

01 / Explore the detail

What an MT4 White Label Actually Gives You

In plain terms, you’re operating on an existing MT4 server that’s already licensed, hosted and maintained. We brand the terminal for you, set up your trading groups and connect it to a back office, so you can start accepting clients without building the infrastructure yourself.

Your traders download a platform carrying your company name. They log in, fund their accounts and trade. They never need to know what’s running underneath.

01

Your Brand, Not Ours

Your logo, company name and colours appear across the terminal, the client portal and the welcome emails. For a new broker, looking established from the first login matters more than people think.

02

Familiar Ground for Traders

Because MT4 is so widely used, most traders need zero training. They can bring their custom indicators and EAs straight over. That removes one of the biggest reasons people hesitate before switching brokers.

02 / Explore the detail

Who Should Become a White Label MT4 Forex Broker?

Running as a white label MT4 forex broker suits a few types of businesses particularly well.

Introducing brokers who already bring in steady volume and want to keep more of the revenue. Trading educators and signal providers with a loyal community who’d rather trade with them directly. Financial firms adding forex alongside an existing product. And first-time founders who want to test their model in a real market before committing to anything bigger.

What these groups have in common is that they know how to find traders. What they usually don’t want is the cost and stress of running a server.

03 / Explore the detail

Why MT4 Still Makes Sense in 2026

MT5 gets most of the attention these days, and for good reason. But MT4 hasn’t gone anywhere. Huge numbers of forex traders still prefer it, particularly in markets where it’s been the standard for years.

01

A Massive Library of Tools

Thousands of indicators, scripts and expert advisors have been written for MT4. Many of them have no MT5 version. Traders who rely on them will choose a broker that supports MT4 every time.

02

Simple and Stable

MT4 is lighter and simpler than its successor. For pure forex trading it does the job well, and experienced traders like that they know exactly how it behaves.

03

Run It Alongside MT5 If You Like

You don’t have to pick one forever. Plenty of brokers launch with MT4 and add MT5 later as they expand into indices, commodities or stocks. We can set up both whenever you’re ready.

04 / Explore the detail

MT4 White Label Turnkey: Everything in One Package

A trading platform on its own isn’t a brokerage. You still need a way to sign clients up, verify them, take deposits and pay out withdrawals. That’s where an MT4 white label turnkey package comes in.

Instead of sourcing each part from a different supplier, you get the whole setup from us, already connected and tested.

01

What the Turnkey Package Covers

Depending on your needs, the package can include a branded MT4 terminal for desktop, web and mobile, a forex CRM with client onboarding and KYC, a trader’s room where clients manage deposits and accounts, payment gateway connections, an IB module for partners and commissions, and a branded website to bring it all together.

02

Why One Supplier Makes Life Easier

When your CRM, payments and platform come from different companies, small problems bounce between them for days. Nobody owns the fix. With a turnkey setup, there’s one team responsible for making it all work, and one number to call when something doesn’t.

05 / Explore the detail

Understanding MT4 White Label Cost

This is usually the first question we get, and it’s a fair one. The honest answer is that MT4 white label cost depends on what you need. A bare platform costs far less than a full turnkey brokerage, and the gap between the two is significant.

01

What Affects the Price

A few things move the number up or down. The number of client accounts you expect. Whether you want MT4 only or MT4 and MT5 together. How much of the turnkey package you take, such as CRM, website and payment integrations. Any extra plugins, like copy trading or PAMM accounts. And the level of ongoing support you need.

02

Setup Fees Versus Monthly Fees

Most white label arrangements have two parts. A one-time setup fee that covers configuration, branding and integration, and a monthly fee for server access, maintenance and support. We break both down clearly in our proposal, so you know what you’re paying for and why.

03

No Surprises Later

Hidden charges are a common complaint in this industry. Extra fees for reports, plugin access or support hours that weren’t mentioned upfront. We list everything before you sign. If something changes, you’ll hear about it before it shows up on an invoice.

06 / Explore the detail

How We Get You Live

The process is simpler than most brokers expect. We start with a call about your markets, client volumes and budget. From there we recommend a setup and send a clear proposal. Once you approve and your documents are ready, we configure the server groups, apply your branding, connect your CRM and payments, and run everything through testing with your team. Then you go live.

You’ll have direct contacts on our team throughout, and they stay with you after launch too.

07 / Explore the detail

Ready to Launch Your MT4 Brokerage?

If your traders already live on MT4, there’s no reason to make them learn something new. An MT4 white label lets you meet them where they are, under your own brand, at a cost that makes sense for a growing business.

Tell us what you’re building and how fast you want to move. Whether you’re after a simple platform or a full MT4 white label turnkey setup, we’ll put together a proposal with clear pricing and a realistic timeline. Becoming a white label MT4 forex broker is easier than you think, and getting a straight answer on MT4 white label cost starts with one quick conversation. Get in touch today.

Scope & responsibilities

The context

MT5 has become the platform most new brokerages build on. It handles forex, metals, indices, stocks, futures and crypto CFDs in one place, and it’s where MetaQuotes now puts almost all of its development effort. For brokers planning to grow, owning that platform outright is a serious step forward.

An MT5 admin license gives your company its own MetaTrader 5 server, licensed in your name, with full administrator access. No provider sitting above you, no limits on how you configure things. This page explains what you get, what it costs, how setup works and whether the timing is right for you.

01 / Operational scope

What an MT5 Admin License Gives You

With your own licence, the server and everything running on it belong to your brokerage. You make the decisions, your team holds the keys.

01

Full Administrator Access

Server settings, plugins, gateways, data feeds, backups and security are all under your control. Your team can act immediately when something needs changing, rather than raising a request and waiting.

02

Freedom to Build Your Product

Choose which asset classes to offer, how each symbol is configured and how trading sessions run. Set spreads, commissions, swaps and leverage by group, by region or by instrument. Your offer can be as simple or as detailed as your business needs.

03

Ownership of Your Data

Client records, trading history and server logs sit on infrastructure your company controls. That makes regulatory reporting, audits and data protection much easier to manage.

02 / Operational scope

Why MT5 Is the Licence Most Brokers Choose Today

Unlike MT4, an MT5 server license is still actively issued and supported by MetaQuotes, which makes it the practical choice for most brokers moving to their own infrastructure.

01

True Multi-Asset Trading

One server can carry forex, metals, energies, indices, stocks, futures and crypto CFDs. As your clients ask for new markets, you add symbols rather than new platforms.

02

Hedging and Netting Support

MT5 lets you run both hedging and netting account types. That means you can serve traditional forex traders and those used to exchange-style position handling from the same server.

03

Better Performance and Tools

The multi-threaded strategy tester, more timeframes, more order types, market depth and a built-in economic calendar all make MT5 attractive to active and algorithmic traders.

04

A Platform That Keeps Improving

New features, gateways and integrations land on MT5 first. Owning an MT5 server means your brokerage stays current without a painful migration down the line.

03 / Operational scope

Understanding MT5 Admin Cost

The MT5 admin cost isn’t a single number. It’s a combination of several parts, and knowing each one helps you budget properly.

01

Licence Fees

The licence itself is issued by MetaQuotes, and its fees are the largest upfront cost. The exact amount depends on the licence package and the arrangement agreed.

02

Hosting and Infrastructure

Your MT5 server needs reliable hosting, ideally in a data centre close to your liquidity providers to keep latency low. Costs depend on location, performance needs and backup requirements.

03

Integrations

A liquidity bridge, forex CRM, client portal, payment gateways and risk management tools all add to your budget. If you already use some of these, we can connect them rather than replace them.

04

Server Management

Someone has to keep the server running smoothly. That could be your in-house team, a managed service from us, or both. Monthly costs depend on the level of support you choose.

05

Getting a Real Number

Every setup is different, so the best way to understand your MT5 admin cost is to tell us your plans. We’ll send an itemised estimate with every part explained.

04 / Operational scope

MT5 Admin Setup: Our Step-by-Step Process

A careful MT5 admin setup is what separates a stable launch from weeks of firefighting. Here’s how we approach it.

01

Step One: Understand Your Business

We look at where you are now. Are you starting fresh, upgrading from a grey label, or moving from MT4? Which markets and asset classes are you targeting? That shapes everything else.

02

Step Two: Licensing Support

We guide you through the MetaQuotes licensing process, the documents involved and what to expect at each stage.

03

Step Three: Server and Hosting

We help you choose hosting, then build and configure your MT5 environment for speed, stability and security.

04

Step Four: Configuration

Groups, symbols, trading sessions, account types and plugins are set up around your business model. If you’re migrating, we replicate what works and fix what doesn’t.

05

Step Five: Integrations and Testing

Your CRM, client portal, payments and liquidity bridge are connected and tested together. Your team runs through real trading and client scenarios before launch.

06

Step Six: Go Live and Ongoing Support

You launch with full administrator access. Afterwards, we can manage the server completely, support your team, or step in only when needed.

05 / Operational scope

Who Should Get an MT5 Admin License?

It’s a strong fit for grey label brokers whose volumes now justify their own server, multi-asset brokers who need deep control over symbols and sessions, firms entering regulated markets where owning infrastructure matters, and MT4 brokers ready to move to a modern platform.

If you’re still testing a market or building your first client base, a white label or grey label is often the smarter first step. We’ll give you an honest view of which suits you.

06 / Operational scope

Own the Platform Your Brokerage Runs On

An MT5 admin license gives you the control, credibility and flexibility that shared setups can’t offer. It’s a big step, and it deserves careful planning and honest advice.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to get an MT5 admin licence?

The licensing review usually takes a few weeks, depending on your documents. Server setup and integrations run alongside it, so you can often launch soon after approval.

Can I move my grey label clients to my own MT5 server?

Yes. We migrate accounts, balances and trading history, usually over a weekend when markets are closed, so your traders face minimal disruption.

Can I keep MT4 running while I move to MT5?

Yes. Some brokers keep MT4 for existing clients while onboarding new traders to MT5. We can set up and manage both during the transition, or for as long as you need.

Do I need my own technical team?

You’ll need someone responsible for server administration. That can be your own staff, our managed service, or a mix. We’ll help you decide what makes sense for your size and budget.

A modern operating foundation

Today’s traders rarely stick to one market. The same client might trade EUR/USD before breakfast, gold at lunch and the Nasdaq in the evening. If your brokerage can only offer part of that, they’ll quietly open an account somewhere else.

An MT5 grey label gives you a platform that handles all of it, under your own brand, with the manager access and control to run your brokerage on your own terms. You skip the cost of a full MT5 server licence but keep the independence that serious brokers need.

01 / Explore the detail

What You Get With an MT5 Grey Label

Your brokerage runs on an MT5 server that’s already licensed, hosted and kept up to date by us. You get your own manager and admin access, your own groups and symbols, and the freedom to set trading conditions the way you want.

We look after the infrastructure. You make the business decisions.

01

A Branded Platform Across Every Device

Your traders log in to a platform carrying your name on desktop, web, iOS and Android. From their side, it’s simply your brokerage.

02

Control From the Manager Terminal

Your team can track positions, watch exposure, manage accounts and change settings in real time. When markets move fast, you don’t need to wait for anyone’s approval.

02 / Explore the detail

Why Become a Grey Label MT5 Broker?

Setting up as a grey label MT5 broker gives you two big advantages at once. A platform designed for multi-asset trading, and the control to make the most of it.

01

Offer More Than Forex

MT5 supports forex, metals, energies, indices, stocks, futures and crypto CFDs in one terminal. You can start with a focused product list and expand when your clients ask for more, without changing platforms or moving accounts.

02

Set Conditions for Each Asset Class

Different instruments need different treatment. With a grey label, you can set separate spreads, commissions, leverage and trading hours by symbol and by group. Your index traders and forex scalpers don’t have to share the same rules.

03

Manage Your Own Risk

Decide how flow is handled across asset classes. Route some to liquidity providers, keep some internally, and adjust as your book changes. For a multi-asset broker, that flexibility matters even more than it does for a pure forex shop.

03 / Explore the detail

Why MT5 Is the Smart Choice for New Grey Label Brokers

MT4 still has its fans, and we support it too. But most brokers launching a grey label today choose MT5, and for good reasons.

01

Built for Where Trading Is Heading

MetaQuotes focuses its development on MT5. New features, integrations and plugins arrive there first. Starting on MT5 keeps your brokerage current for years rather than months.

02

Better Tools for Active and Algo Traders

More timeframes, more order types, market depth, a built-in economic calendar and a much faster multi-threaded strategy tester. Experienced traders pick up on these quickly and appreciate them.

03

Hedging and Netting Modes

MT5 supports both hedging and netting account types. That gives you flexibility to serve traditional forex traders as well as those used to exchange-style position handling.

04 / Explore the detail

Our MT5 Grey Label Solution

Our MT5 grey label solution is designed to give you a working brokerage from day one, not just a server login.

01

Core Setup

A branded MT5 environment across all devices. Manager and admin terminals. Configured groups, symbols and trading conditions for each asset class. Connection to your liquidity bridge and back office tools.

02

Optional Extras

A forex CRM with KYC and onboarding, a trader’s room for deposits and withdrawals, payment gateway integrations, an IB and affiliate module and a branded website. Copy trading, PAMM and MAM plugins can be added as you grow.

03

Everything Connected Properly

We configure and test each part together, so client data, deposits and reports line up across the platform and CRM. Fewer manual fixes means more time spent on actually growing the business.

One connected environment

05 / Explore the detail

Understanding MT5 Grey Label Cost

The MT5 grey label cost sits comfortably between a white label and a full licence. The exact figure depends on the size and shape of your setup.

01

What Shapes the Price

Expected client numbers. How many asset classes and symbols you want to offer. Whether you need MT5 alone or alongside MT4. Which add-ons you include, such as CRM, payments and website. And the support level you choose.

02

How Fees Are Structured

A one-time setup fee covers configuration, branding, integrations and testing. A monthly fee covers server access, maintenance and support. Both are listed clearly in your proposal.

03

Pricing Without Surprises

Routine changes are covered in your monthly fee. Anything outside your package gets quoted before work starts, and you decide whether to go ahead. No unexpected lines on your invoice.

06 / Explore the detail

Who an MT5 Grey Label Suits

It’s a strong fit for brokers planning to offer multiple asset classes, white label brokers ready for more control, fintech or investment firms adding CFDs to their products, and founders with experienced dealing staff who want flexibility from the start. If your growth plans go beyond forex, MT5 is usually the right base to build on.

07 / Explore the detail

Build Your Brokerage on MT5

Traders want choice, speed and modern tools. An MT5 grey label gives them all three, under your brand, while giving you the control to shape your offer and manage your risk.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I offer stocks and crypto CFDs on an MT5 grey label?

Yes. MT5 handles stocks, indices, commodities, futures and crypto CFDs alongside forex. What you can offer also depends on your liquidity providers and licensing, which we can talk through during setup.

Will traders used to MT4 struggle with MT5?

Most adjust within a day or two, as the layout is similar. The main hurdle is custom MT4 indicators and EAs, which need MQL5 versions. If that’s a concern, we can run MT4 alongside MT5.

How long does an MT5 grey label take to launch?

A standard setup can go live within a few days once your documents, branding and trading conditions are agreed. Multi-asset configurations with many symbols may need a little more time, and we’ll let you know upfront.

Can I switch from an MT5 white label to a grey label?

Yes. Since both run on our infrastructure, we can move your groups and client accounts across with minimal disruption. Many brokers make this step once their volumes grow.

The context

Traders want more than currency pairs these days. They want gold in the morning, US indices in the afternoon and maybe a few stocks or crypto CFDs on the side. If your platform can’t keep up, they’ll find one that can.

MetaTrader 5 was built for that kind of trading. With an MT5 white label, you get the full platform under your own brand, ready for clients across multiple asset classes, without paying for a server licence or building infrastructure from scratch.

01 / Explore the detail

What You Get With an MT5 White Label

You run your brokerage on an MT5 server that’s already licensed, hosted and kept up to date. We brand the platform with your name and logo, set up your account groups and symbols, and connect it to a back office so you can start onboarding clients quickly.

Your traders see your brand on desktop, web and mobile. Everything underneath is managed for you.

01

Multi-Asset From the Start

MT5 handles forex, metals, energies, indices, stocks and futures in one terminal. You can launch with a tight product list and add more instruments as your clients ask for them, without changing platforms.

02

A Platform Built for Modern Traders

More timeframes, more order types, a built-in economic calendar, market depth and a far stronger strategy tester. Active traders and algo traders notice the difference quickly.

02 / Explore the detail

Who Should Become a White Label MT5 Forex Broker?

Launching as a white label MT5 forex broker works especially well if you’re planning to offer more than forex, or if your audience is younger and less tied to older tools.

It suits introducing brokers expanding into their own brand, fintech and investment firms that want CFDs alongside existing products, trading communities with followers interested in indices and commodities, and new founders who want a platform that won’t feel dated in a few years.

If your plans include stocks, crypto CFDs or futures at any point, starting on MT5 saves you a migration later.

03 / Explore the detail

MT5 vs MT4: Why More Brokers Are Choosing MT5

MT4 still has a loyal following, and we support it. But most new brokerages we work with now start on MT5, and the reasons are fairly practical.

01

Wider Range of Instruments

MT4 was designed mainly for forex. MT5 handles exchange-traded instruments and a much broader mix of CFDs, which gives you more to offer and more ways to earn.

02

Better Tools for Algo Traders

The MT5 strategy tester is multi-threaded and much faster, and MQL5 is a more powerful language than its predecessor. Traders building and testing EAs tend to prefer it once they’ve tried it.

03

Where the Industry Is Heading

MetaQuotes has focused its development on MT5 for years. New features, integrations and plugins land there first. Choosing MT5 now keeps your brokerage aligned with where the platform ecosystem is going.

04

You Can Still Offer Both

If part of your audience is attached to MT4, we can run both platforms side by side. Clients pick what they’re comfortable with, and you don’t lose anyone over a platform preference.

04 / Explore the detail

MT5 White Label Turnkey: The Whole Brokerage, Ready to Go

A branded platform is a strong start, but clients also need to register, pass KYC, deposit funds and reach support. An MT5 white label turnkey package brings all of that together in one setup.

01

What’s Included

Depending on what you need, the package can cover a branded MT5 platform across desktop, web, iOS and Android, a forex CRM with onboarding and KYC, a trader’s room for deposits, withdrawals and account management, payment gateway integrations, an IB and affiliate module, and a branded website. Optional extras like copy trading, PAMM and MAM accounts can be added as you grow.

02

One Team Responsible for All of It

Every piece is configured and tested together before launch. If something goes wrong later, there’s no chain of vendors pointing at each other. You call us, and we fix it.

05 / Explore the detail

What Does MT5 White Label Cost?

We get asked this on almost every first call. The real answer is that MT5 white label cost depends on how much you need. A standalone branded platform sits at one end. A full turnkey brokerage with CRM, payments and website sits at the other.

01

The Main Cost Factors

The biggest things that shape your price are the number of client accounts you expect, how many asset classes and symbols you want to offer, whether you need MT5 alone or alongside MT4, how much of the turnkey package you take, and which plugins and support level you choose.

02

How Fees Are Usually Structured

Typically there’s a one-time setup fee for configuration, branding and integrations, plus a monthly fee for server access, maintenance and support. Our proposal shows both clearly, line by line.

03

Clear Pricing, No Late Surprises

We don’t believe in a low headline price followed by extra charges for reports, plugins or support time. You’ll see the full picture before you sign. If anything changes down the line, we’ll talk to you first.

06 / Explore the detail

From First Call to Go Live

We start by understanding your plans. Your target markets, the instruments you want to offer, expected client numbers and budget. Then we recommend a setup and send a proposal.

Once you’ve approved it and your documents are ready, we configure your groups and symbols, apply your branding, connect CRM and payments, and test everything with your team before launch. You’ll have direct contacts throughout, and they stay with you long after go live.

07 / Explore the detail

Launch Your MT5 Brokerage With Confidence

Traders expect more choice than ever, and MT5 lets you give it to them under your own name. An MT5 white label gets you to market quickly with a platform built for where trading is heading, not where it’s been.

Becoming a white label MT5 forex broker is more achievable than most people think, and a straight answer on MT5 white label cost is one conversation away. Get in touch today.

Offshore Company Formation

Connect the platform, trading conditions and client workflows around the way your brokerage operates.

Discuss your requirements ↗

The context

Many brokers don’t start in London, Sydney or New York. They start offshore. It’s often quicker, more affordable and far less complicated than setting up in a major financial centre, which is why so many successful brokerages began this way.

Offshore forex company formation gives you a legal base to operate from, open accounts with partners and start building your client base. Done well, it’s a smart first step. Done carelessly, it can leave you with a company that banks won’t touch and partners won’t onboard. This page walks you through how to get it right.

01 / Explore the detail

Why Brokers Choose an Offshore Setup

01

Lower Costs

Registration fees, ongoing government charges and minimum capital requirements are usually far lower than in major onshore jurisdictions.

02

Faster Setup

Company registration in many offshore locations can be completed relatively quickly, letting you move on to licensing, banking and technology sooner.

03

Simpler Requirements

Fewer local staffing rules, lighter reporting and less complex corporate structures make offshore setups more manageable for new founders.

04

International Reach

Offshore companies are often used by brokers serving clients across many countries, particularly in emerging markets.

02 / Explore the detail

What to Weigh Up Before You Commit

Offshore setups aren’t right for everyone, and it’s better to know the trade-offs now than discover them later.

01

Restricted Markets

Some countries don’t allow offshore brokers to market to or accept their residents. You’ll need to know which markets are off limits for your structure.

02

Banking Challenges

Some banks are cautious about offshore financial companies. Strong documentation, clear ownership and solid compliance policies help a lot.

03

Partner Expectations

Certain liquidity providers and payment processors prefer brokers with stronger regulation, or ask for extra checks for offshore entities.

04

Client Perception

Some traders specifically look for brokers regulated in well-known jurisdictions. Others care more about pricing and service. Knowing your audience helps you decide.

03 / Explore the detail

How to Form a Forex Brokerage Company Offshore

If you’re ready to form forex brokerage company structures offshore, the process usually follows a similar path, whichever jurisdiction you pick.

01

Step One: Choose the Right Jurisdiction

Look at your target markets, budget, timeline and whether you’ll need a licence there. Each location has its own reputation, costs and rules.

02

Step Two: Plan Your Structure

Decide on shareholders, directors and ownership. Some founders use holding companies or separate entities for different functions, depending on their plans.

03

Step Three: Prepare Documents

Expect to provide identification, proof of address, a business plan and sometimes references or source of funds information for directors and shareholders.

04

Step Four: Register the Company

Your corporate service provider files the incorporation documents with the local registry and sets up a registered office address.

05

Step Five: Apply for a Licence, If Needed

Where a licence is available or required, prepare your application, policies and capital in line with the regulator’s rules.

06

Step Six: Open Bank and Payment Accounts

With your company and licence in place, apply for corporate banking, payment processor accounts and liquidity provider relationships.

04 / Explore the detail

Incorporate Forex Broker Entities the Right Way

When you incorporate forex broker entities, small details make a big difference later on.

01

Use a Reputable Corporate Service Provider

Experienced providers know what each registry expects, prepare documents properly and avoid delays caused by missing information.

02

Be Transparent About Ownership

Banks and partners want to know who’s behind the business. Clear, well-documented ownership makes onboarding much smoother.

03

Put Policies in Place Early

AML, KYC, risk management and client fund handling policies are often required for licensing and banking. Having them ready from the start saves time.

04

Think About the Future

If you plan to add an onshore licence later, structure your offshore company in a way that won’t need to be torn down and rebuilt.

05 / Explore the detail

Is Cheap Company Formation Forex Worth It?

Searching for cheap company formation forex packages is understandable when budgets are tight. Some lower-cost options are perfectly fine. Others cut corners in ways that hurt later.

01

Where Saving Money Makes Sense

Simple jurisdictions with straightforward requirements, standard corporate structures and providers who are clear about what’s included.

02

Where It Can Backfire

Unknown providers with vague pricing, jurisdictions with poor reputations among banks, missing compliance documents or structures that partners refuse to work with. A company you can’t bank is not really a saving.

03

Ask the Right Questions

What exactly is included? Are government fees covered? Is there help with bank account applications? What are the ongoing annual costs? Clear answers usually point to a trustworthy provider.

06 / Explore the detail

How We Fit In

We focus on the technology that powers your brokerage, but we know how much it depends on your company setup.

01

Partner Introductions

We can point you towards corporate and legal service providers experienced in offshore forex company formation and licensing.

02

Technology Ready in Parallel

While your company and licence are being set up, we can prepare your trading platform, CRM, payments and liquidity connections, so you can launch soon after approval.

03

Configured for Your Jurisdiction

Client restrictions by country, KYC requirements and onboarding steps are set up to match your company’s licence and target markets.

07 / Explore the detail

Start Your Brokerage With the Right Foundation

A well-planned offshore setup can get your brokerage moving quickly without draining your budget. The key is choosing carefully and doing it properly from day one.

Whether you’re exploring offshore forex company formation, ready to form forex brokerage company structures, looking to incorporate forex broker entities, or comparing cheap company formation forex options, we’ll help you connect your legal setup with technology that’s ready to launch. Get in touch today.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does offshore forex company formation take?

Company registration can be completed fairly quickly in many jurisdictions. Licensing and bank account opening usually take longer, so plan your timeline around those steps.

Do I need to live in the offshore jurisdiction?

Often not, though some jurisdictions require local directors, a local office or a registered agent. Requirements vary, so check with your corporate service provider.

Can I accept clients from any country with an offshore company?

No. Some countries restrict offshore brokers from soliciting their residents. Your legal advisor should confirm which markets you can serve.

Can I move to an onshore licence later?

Yes. Many brokers start offshore and add a licence in a more established jurisdiction as they grow. Planning for this early makes the transition easier.

Connect the platform, trading conditions and client workflows around the way your brokerage operates.

The context

Nothing frustrates a trader faster than money problems. A deposit that doesn’t show up in their account. A withdrawal that sits pending for days with no explanation. Even if everything else about your brokerage is excellent, payment issues are what clients remember and talk about.

On your side, manual payment handling eats up hours. Someone checks the payment provider dashboard, matches it to a client, credits the trading account, records it in the CRM, then does the same thing in reverse for withdrawals. Multiply that by hundreds of transactions a day and mistakes are almost guaranteed.

Forex deposit automation and forex withdrawal automation fix both problems. Money moves faster for clients, and your team gets its time back.

01 / Explore the detail

How Forex Deposit Automation Works

When deposits are automated, the whole journey from payment to trading balance happens without anyone on your team touching it.

01

Client Starts the Deposit

The client logs in to the trader’s room, picks an account and payment method, and enters an amount.

02

Payment Is Processed

They’re taken to the payment provider’s secure page, where they complete the payment by card, bank transfer, e-wallet, local method or crypto.

03

Confirmation Comes Back

Once the provider confirms the payment, a notification is sent straight back to your CRM.

04

Trading Account Is Credited

The CRM credits the client’s MT4 or MT5 account automatically. The balance updates, the transaction is recorded and the client gets a confirmation email.

05

Everything Is Logged

The deposit appears in your back office with full details, ready for finance and compliance teams to review whenever they need.

02 / Explore the detail

How Forex Withdrawal Automation Works

Withdrawals need more care than deposits, because money is leaving your brokerage. Automation here is about speed and control at the same time.

01

Client Submits a Request

The client requests a withdrawal in the trader’s room. The system checks their available balance, free margin and verification status before accepting the request.

02

Rules Decide the Next Step

You set the rules. Small withdrawals from fully verified clients might be approved automatically. Larger amounts, new payment details or flagged accounts go to your finance team for review.

03

Approval and Processing

Once approved, funds are deducted from the trading account and the payout is sent through the payment provider, ideally back to the same method the client used to deposit.

04

Client Stays Informed

The client can see the status of their request at every stage and receives updates by email.

03 / Explore the detail

CRM Payment Integration: Why It Matters

Proper CRM payment integration is the link that makes automation possible. Without it, your CRM and your payment providers are two separate systems, and your team is the bridge between them.

01

One Source of Truth

When payments flow through the CRM, every transaction lives in one place. Finance, support and compliance all see the same numbers.

02

Accurate Balances

Deposits and withdrawals sync with MetaTrader automatically, so client balances always match what’s recorded in your back office.

03

Fewer Errors

No more crediting the wrong account, entering the wrong amount or forgetting to record a transaction.

04

Faster Reconciliation

Your finance team can match CRM records against payment provider reports quickly, rather than spending days on spreadsheets.

04 / Explore the detail

Forex PSP Integration Options

Every market has its preferred ways to pay. Good forex PSP integration means you can offer the methods your clients actually use.

01

Cards

Visa and Mastercard through card processors that work with forex brokers.

02

Bank Transfers

Local and international bank transfers, with automatic matching where the provider supports it.

03

E-Wallets

Popular digital wallets used in different regions.

04

Local Payment Methods

Region-specific options that can make a big difference to conversion rates in certain markets.

05

Crypto

Crypto deposits and withdrawals through providers that support brokers, where your licence allows it.

06

Multiple Providers

Connect several payment service providers so you have backup options, better coverage across regions and the ability to route transactions smartly.

05 / Explore the detail

Control and Security Features

Automation shouldn’t mean losing control. These features keep your money and your clients’ money safe.

01

Approval Limits

Set thresholds for automatic approval and require manual review above them.

02

Return-to-Source Rules

Send withdrawals back to the original deposit method where possible, which helps prevent fraud and supports AML compliance.

03

Verification Gates

Block deposits or withdrawals until clients reach the required KYC level.

04

Fraud Flags

Highlight unusual patterns, like rapid deposits and withdrawals, mismatched names or new payment details.

05

Full Audit Trail

Every transaction and approval is logged with timestamps and the staff member involved.

06 / Explore the detail

Built Into Your Brokerage Setup

With our grey label and turnkey packages, payment automation is configured as part of your CRM, trader’s room and back office. We connect your chosen payment providers, set up your approval rules and test every deposit and withdrawal scenario before launch.

Already working with specific PSPs? We’ll integrate them. Need help finding providers that work with brokers in your markets? We can point you in the right direction.

Whether you need reliable forex deposit automation, controlled forex withdrawal automation, properly connected CRM payment integration or broader forex PSP integration across your markets, we’ll help you set it up properly. Get in touch today.

Answers, without the ambiguity

Frequently Asked Questions

How quickly are automated deposits credited?

Usually as soon as the payment provider confirms the transaction. For card and many e-wallet payments, that’s often within moments. Bank transfers may take longer depending on the provider.

Can I approve withdrawals manually?

Yes. You decide which withdrawals are approved automatically and which need manual review, based on amount, client type, payment method or risk level.

Can I connect more than one payment provider?

Yes. Many brokers use several PSPs for different regions and payment methods. All of them can be connected to the same CRM.

Do I need my own accounts with payment providers?

Yes. You’ll need merchant accounts with your chosen PSPs. We handle the technical integration once those accounts are set up.

08 / Explore the detail

Make Payments the Easiest Part of Your Brokerage

When deposits land instantly and withdrawals move without drama, clients trust you more and your team works faster.
